title: Create an object
summary: Make an equipment item, function, area or other object from a library class allowed in the section.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Make several objects at once
summary: Create up to 100 objects of one class in one go, numbered after the tag or name you type.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: The object window and its tabs
summary: Each object's own tab: header with class, tag and name, and the tabs Attributes, Relationships, Deep view, Data sheet, Chat, History and Attachments.
roles: Anyone who can open the project; editing needs a role that may edit objects

title: Fill in attributes: values, units, pick lists and required values
summary: Enter values with units, choose from pick lists, filter the attributes and see which required values are missing.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Sub-attributes
summary: Read and fill indented sub-attributes such as Design pressure / In, and add your own to one object.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Add an attribute to one object
summary: Add a library attribute or a free text attribute to a single object.
roles: The permission to add attributes to objects

training.topic: Adding an attribute to one object

title: Automatic tags and reference designations
summary: New objects are tagged from the project's rules (P-001, P-002) with their designation, and a tag whose input changed is marked out of date.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Set a manual tag with Tag…
summary: See where a tag comes from and set a manual tag, or go back to the rule's tag.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Retag… with preview
summary: Give objects the tags their rules give now, after a preview of every old and new tag.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Set up tag rules for a project
summary: Build a project's tag rules from segments, lookup tables and options, see a sample, test against the project and save.
roles: A project role that may change the project's settings

title: Relate objects
summary: Connect objects, for example a function that is implemented by a pump: pick the other object in a tree of what fits, or drag one onto the other in the explorer with the right mouse button; see it from both sides and remove it.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Hookups: how instruments are fixed and connected
summary: Turn hookups on for a project, make them in Assets ▸ Hookups with their type, mounting, drawing and bill of material, choose on every instrument which hookup it uses, and see on every hookup the instruments that use it.
roles: A project role that may configure the project (to turn hookups on); a license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Rename an object
summary: Change an object's name in the explorer or in its window.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Cases of an object
summary: Make variants of an object that inherit its values until you type their own.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Move an object
summary: Drag an object to a folder or section where its class may live.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Void an object
summary: Take an object out of use without deleting it; unvoid it from the Voided bin.
roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

title: Delete an object, restore it, or delete it permanently
summary: Delete moves an object to the Deleted bin; Restore brings it back, and Delete permanently… previews what goes with it.
roles: A license and a project role that may delete objects

title: Deep view
summary: A graphical view of an object; today the tab and menu item show a placeholder.

title: Units of measurement
summary: Type the number and choose the unit beside it; changing the unit of a value asks Convert or Change unit only.

title: Calculations and copy rules on attributes
summary: Attribute values computed from other attributes or related objects, check rules and copy rules are planned in M6 Rules.
